verdict.rationale: Polar demonstrably ships versioned OpenAPI specs (2026-04 and 2026-10) served live from the docs site, confirming an API versioning scheme exists, but no evidence describes a documented deprecation policy, sunset timeline, or migration guidance between API versions. Missing for 10: explicit deprecation/sunset policy documentation, version lifecycle guarantees, and migration guides between the 2026-04 and 2026-10 versions.
